Sets how much a body grips what it touches (default 0.2). Two bodies use the square root of the product of both. 0 is ice.
@param entity The body.
@param friction 0 or more, usually up to 1.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
